exposure: Combination of levothyroxine and prednisolone treatment
cohort: The cohort consisted of 190 infertile patients with positive thyroid autoantibodies (anti-T and anti-TPO) undergoing in vitro fertilization (IVF) treatment.
finding: Levothyroxine treatment significantly decreased anti-TPO levels and increased the live birth rate compared to the control group in IVF patients with positive thyroid autoantibodies.
